newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise November rubber futures margin fees.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise November rubber futures margin fees.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Tuesday that it would raise the margin requirement on its November rubber futures contract by 20,000 yen per trading lot, effective from Wednesday.
This increase, aimed at cooling overheated trade, will bring the total margin requirement on the November contract to 127,750 yen.
The requirement on other rubber contracts will be unchanged at 52,500 yen, TOCOM said in a statement.
